approval_source.question_set: Whether the startup check's scope with a checkpoint (PR #136) is an approved value, and how often the complete check must run (user, 13 November 2026: 'proceed with your recommendations on the remaining items')

reason: Staging sentry startup failure of 2026-11-10 (BOUNDED_STARTUP_FAILURE, height 173,074); root cause in draft PR #135, fix in PR #136. Startup no longer re-reads records below the checkpoint (except block 1, control records and their anchors); those checks run in dytallix-state-check. The list is in the design ref.

decisions.question: Startup check scope
decisions.selected: Approve the scope as listed in startup-checkpoint.md
decisions.rule: Every state-wide check and the verifier replays stay at every start; only per-record checks below the checkpoint move to the complete check.

decisions.question: Cadence of the complete check
decisions.selected: On a stopped copy at each quarterly restore drill, before each release upgrade, and after any unexplained stop
decisions.rule: A complete-check failure is a Severity 1 incident (supply-mismatch or fork runbook by class).
